notes.title: Biiiiiiig update is here!
notes.notes:
Raging Titan is back! Now this is what I call an update. The game has been completely reworked and there’s nearly no area that hasn’t gotten some love in the last couple of days and weeks, and here is the final result! Have a look at the list of changes and give it a try!


 Rebalanced costs, damage, fire rates and ranges of all towers and their respective upgrade levels
 Reworked visuals and props in many levels
 Reworking lighting to be less demanding while still looking better than before
 Decreased volume of enemy portals, machine-gun tower and anti air gun
 Fixed issues with projectile movement
 Reworked user interface and added new graphics
 Reworked level selection screen
 Added voice overs to the tutorial
 Added alarm sound effect when airborne enemies approach
 Decreased lives of command HQ
 Doubled points given by enemies
 Fixed display of global average stats
 Added new options to change the sound, music and voice over volume
 Added option to switch target display
 Added different colours for each portal to make enemy wave directions more obvious
 Added click audio effect when hitting buttons for audio feedback
 Fixing build menu sometimes being a bit reluctant to accept clicks
 Added button to proceed from loading screen to allow players to read game hints
 Fixing the health bars display
 Showing damage factor increase from augmenter towers directly above affected towers
 Reducing scroll speed when at borders
 Gazillions of other bug fixes

notes.title: Summer update!
notes.notes:
The Summer Update!

It's been a while since the last update and so it is time to get you the latest fixes on the game. Here's the complete list:

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26476405/5c34643d06242b0ad787d4f1dafa13aa61e0d379.jpg


4 new levels in the new level pack "Archipelago"
Switch profiles for towers - either use a "balanced" profile which is the usual behavior, or trade damage for increased range!
New Superweapon added! You may now emit a deadly blast from your HQ, vaporizing everything in range! It takes a while to reload, and the more often you use it the longer it takes, so choose wisely when to use it!
Added ability to quickly jump to the HQ (UI button or C key)
Fixed towers somestimes being hard to select without centering the camera first
Increased base range for Rocket and Plasma Towers
Removed sharing functionalities
Removing rewarded actions
Removed some debris from levels "Dead Roads" and "Downtown Destruction"
Reworked explosions to not be too obtructive
Fixed bad lightning in "Earths Inner"
Fixed sounds from the HQ not playing
Fixed UI icons sometimes showing wrong
Fixed some option toggles which were not working from time to time
Fixed cursor sometimes not showing up


Have fun!

notes.title: No time to be lazy - Update for Hotkeys and Air Paths
notes.notes:
The last update was not published long ago, but here are some more additions to the game which are now available with the latest update.

As you can see this update mainly focuses on giving you additional hotkey controls in menus. Also there are changing in how the air paths are displayed.

Full change list here:


Air paths can now be shown at will by toggling them with the corresponding button in the upper right corner in the game (or using the H key). Note: Blinking air paths will still be shown once airborne enemies have been spawned
Air path default visibility can be set in the options menu
Use the middle mouse key to scroll the camera
Right-mouse can now be used to go back in or close the main menu, build menu and upgrade menu
Hotkey added: Press T when a tower is selected to upgrade it
Hotkey added: Press X when a tower is selected to sell it
Hotkey added: Press 1 when a Nanite Tower is selected to toggle the nanite target
Hotkeys added: Use numeric keys 1-4 to navigate the build menu and buy towers
Showing loading overlay in main menu to clearly indicate that things are currently loading and you need to be patient for a second
Loading all scores of a level group at once now (in sequence) and showing level selection once the first level score is available. The rest is loaded asynchronousl
Adding and changing some ingame message hints
Fixed issue that if the user score was not among the top 50 of the level it was not displayed in the level selection at all
Achievements in connection with levels played will now only be unlocked if the level is actually played to the end (no matter if won or lost) rather than only started

notes.title: Choo-choo! Update 2 arriving!
notes.notes:
Finally it's about time for the next update, and this time it brings a lot of features, fixes and changes and also stuff you have been specifically asking for.

Let's not talk to much and praise the gods of game development or similar - just have a look at the changelog!

Hope you enjoy it!

New & Improved

Showing clear tower and enemy data in glossary instead of generic texts
Upgrades of towers are visible in glossary as well now
Showing tower data ingame when hovering over the build button with the mouse
Showing tower upgrade data ingame when hovering over the upgrade button
Also showing money you get when selling
Showing user play statistics in main menu (new "Statistics" button)
Showing global average play statistics in Statistics screen
Allow to use ESC key in main menu for backwards navigation


Changes

Early release bonus for waves now calculated differently: For each wave skipped the target wave will get a bonus factor of 0.1 to points with a maximum of 1.2. Money bonus is exactly half of that.
However, with a delay of 10 seconds after the enemy was spawned the bonus will drop by 0.1 every second until no bonus is left.
Enemies killed while being influenced by Nanite Emitters or Decelerators will grant an additional bonus of 0.1 to money and points
All towers have been rebalanced with changes in costs, damage, fire rate and range. For details have a look at the glossary
Heavy Raider's resistance against both types of damage adjusted
Granting damage bonus if enemy is damage with matching weapon type
Flying enemies are now clearly indicated in the wave queue as well
Decreasing time to hold down on button to release all waves to 1 second (previously: 2 seconds)
Hitting M (shortcut for releasing all waves) in the prewarm screen will now not only start the game but indeed also start all waves
Tutorial button has been moved to level group selection screen


Fixes

Minor fix for pathfinding in "Uphill Rush"
Minor fix for possible build positions in "Marksman's Paradise"
Minor fix for possible build positions in "Earths Inner"
Minor fix for possible build positions in "Magma Trident"
Fixing issue in order of score submission vs score loading
Fixing despawning of enemies which already have despawned
Fixing effect of Nanite Tower level 3
Fixing Mortar Projectile not causing area damage when not directly hitting an enemy

notes.title: First update!
notes.notes:
BIg thanks to all the players who have bought the game so far, and a especially big thank you to all of you who provided so constant feedback and proposals for improvements!

This is so valuable, and of course you shall not be disappointed, so here it is, the first bigger update to the game (apart from a hotfix in the early day).

Update 1
Improvements

 Moving the camera or zooming when the game has stopped (e.g. you won the level) is not possible anymore. This should help when scrolling through the leaderboards or using mouse and keyboard for various other reasons
 Scores for the selected level group in the main menu are now loaded all at once instead only when clicking on the level selection entry. So now you can immediately see which levels you have won, or even ranked first (just allow it a second or two to really fetch the scores)!
 Display of level groups in the main menu has been improved - no scrolling should be needed anymore
 Some new icons in the main menu
 AI pathfinding slightly improved


Fixes

 The rank should now be correct when finishing a level
 The leaderboard should now display all player names and also in the correct order
 Achievements are working correctly now (was previously released in a hotfix)
 Towers cannot be built too close to the level border anymore in most levels
 It's not possible anymore to build towers inside of the HQ or the enemy portals
 UI fixes when scrolling through the leaderboard at the end of a level


Again, thank you all for playing the game and all your feedback!
I hope you enjoy the game!

Also, in case you want new features, find any nasty bugs or just want to chat a bit join us here in the community group, leave a message, open a thread or alike!
